I have implemented fine-grained persisted query restoration and state reconciliation across TanStack Query core and framework adapters on a new branch `fix/persisted-query-state`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **New Public Helper (`createPersisterRestoreResult`)**:
   - Added and exported `createPersisterRestoreResult` from [`packages/query-core/src/index.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-c4cj20wm/packages/query-core/src/index.ts#L45-L51) and [`packages/query-core/src/persister.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-c4cj20wm/packages/query-core/src/persister.ts#L18-L30).
   - Accepts `{ data, state }` and returns a marked snapshot result to signal to TanStack Query that a persisted snapshot was restored.

2. **Query Restoration Path (`Query.prototype.fetch`)**:
   - Updated `Query.prototype.fetch` in [`packages/query-core/src/query.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-c4cj20wm/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L559-L578) to detect when a persister returns a restored snapshot marker.
   - Adopts the provided query state without invoking normal fetch success callbacks (`onSuccess`/`onSettled`).
   - Ensures `fetchStatus` ends in `'idle'`, preserves error states (`isRefetchError`), counters (`fetchFailureCount`), timestamps (`dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdatedAt`), invalidation markers (`isInvalidated`), and infinite query pagination state (`pages`, `pageParams`).

3. **State Reconciliation Logic (`reconcileQueryState`)**:
   - Implemented `reconcileQueryState` in [`packages/query-core/src/persister.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-c4cj20wm/packages/query-core/src/persister.ts#L41-L136) to merge data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) independently when restoring over existing live queries.
   - Preserves live data when live cache has newer data while adopting newer error metadata from storage (preserving refetch error status), and vice-versa.

4. **Fine-grained Storage Persister (`experimental_createQueryPersister`)**:
   - Updated `retrieveQuery` and `persisterFn` in [`packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-c4cj20wm/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L151-L235) to return `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data, state })`.
   - Updated `restoreQueries` in [`packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-c4cj20wm/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L305-L325) for bulk restoration to reconcile live query state with persisted snapshots using `reconcileQueryState`.

5. **Tests**:
   - Added unit tests in [`packages/query-core/src/__tests__/persister.test.tsx`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-c4cj20wm/packages/query-core/src/__tests__/persister.test.tsx).
   - Added fine-grained persistence and bulk restoration reconciliation tests in [`packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersister.test.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-c4cj20wm/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersister.test.ts#L768-L940).
   - Added observer result validation tests in [`packages/react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-c4cj20wm/packages/react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx#L180-L390).
All changes have been successfully implemented, tested, built, and committed on branch `fix/persisted-query-state`.
